claims.claim: The study compares two official Fama-French historical archive vintages on a common monthly calendar.
evidence: official archive URLs captured by execution

claims.claim: Observed vintage differences measure archive/construction-regime sensitivity and are not automatically the pure causal effect of FIZ-to-CIZ.
DCS and alpha/conclusion sensitivity differ from zero or are economically material for specified series/models.
Any reported mean-revision evidence remains reliable after the pre-specified multiplicity procedure.
Damodaran industry results are complementary benchmarking evidence only and do not validate the FIZ-to-CIZ transition.
Any latent factor-dimension difference is independently validated and economically interpretable.
